payload.description: The text of one note or journal day whose hashtag checks are wanted, as the editor shows it.

kind.description: note: a note's body. day: a journal day's text.

id.description: The note's or the journal day's id.

text.description: The whole text, whose hashtag lines are read.

reply.description: The same report text.checked carries, from the answers already kept only: nothing is asked, so a line with no answer kept is left out. Or why it cannot answer.

source.description: The note or the journal day the text is.

kind.description: note: a note's body. day: a journal day's text.

id.description: The note's or the journal day's id.

tags.description: Every hashtag of the text's hashtag lines, in the text's order, each once.

evaluator.description: The account's evaluator whose short name is the tag; null when none matches, so the tag checks nothing.

lines.description: Every line a hashtag line names that has a letter or digit and that Jev has answered, is checking, or could not check, in the text's order; a line still being written is left out until the user finishes it.

status.description: pending: waiting for Jev. done: answered. failed: Jev could not be asked; error says why.

marks.description: What is shown at the line's end, one per question of the evaluators named for it, or one per evaluator for an evaluator marked combined, in the order of the tags and then of each evaluator's questions; empty until done. A yes / no question answered no has no mark. An evaluator shown as one mark (combined) has one mark for the line in place of one per question.

items.description: Jev's answer to one question about the line, as it is shown.

option.description: The answer: the id of a pick-one question's option, or yes for a yes / no question.

name.description: What the mark says: the option's name, or the question's short name for a yes.

icon.description: The icon of the chosen option, by its name in the icon set; left out when the option has none.

p.description: How likely Jev holds the answer to be.

tone.description: How the mark is colored: right, wrong or plain. Present only on the one mark an evaluator shown as one mark (combined) gets; left out on every other mark.

error.description: Why the last check failed, as llm: decide said it; left out when nothing failed.
Why there is no report, such as not-ready.
